column1: # D2 spectrum-matched control: does the endpoint respond to the donor's parameter scale and
# spectrum, or to its learned content? Four cells in one slot on four cards.
# The pilot's within-group derangement recovered 0.210 of the ceiling-minus-floor gap while
# the correctly assigned attention_q1 recovered 0.066, which leaves two readings open. These
# cells install the donor's exact singular values with random orthogonal factors: its scale
# and spectrum exactly, its content not at all. Recovering about 0.2 makes the movement a
# scale effect and closes single-group transplant as a localisation route at any granularity;
# recovering nothing makes the donor's content operative and the pilot's failure one of
# The floor and ceiling are re-derived here because this dispatch carries a different code
# digest from the pilot's: a control at a different digest from what it calibrates is the
# ambiguity a control exists to remove.
# attention_q1 matches the derangement directly; mlp_q3 is the largest MLP share and a
# different shape class, so the reading is not specific to one group's geometry.
# These are controls, not treatments. They interpret a negative and cannot convert one:
# the ten single-group cells still cross zero at every seed, so condition 2 still fails and
# the pilot still does not enter Paper 1 whichever way this falls.
